schemaNote: Phase 0B.2 evidence-status ledger (Issue #182 / PR #183 comment #5774835400). This is the single source of truth for 'how much of the owner-reported 172-entry PIZZA DB population does this repo actually have externally-relayed evidence for, and how much is still missing.' No name, count, or recipe row in this file is invented -- every 'pending' entry has zero content, by design, until real evidence is relayed. Read by tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py, which fails the build if this file's own invariants are violated (see that script's docstring).

ja-172.label: PIZZA DB Japanese canonical population (日本語トップ/比較ページ)

en-160.label: PIZZA DB English translated subset
en-160.note: A translated SUBSET of ja-172, not a separate or interchangeable population. No count, name, or ingredient sourced from en-160 may be used to mark a ja-172 gap as filled. Enforced by tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py's population-tag check.

recipeRowEvidence.evidencedCountNote: Updated in Phase 0B.7: 25 Phase-0B-original comparison_table_sample rows + 16 later comparison_table_sample rows (page 4 + page 1 batches) + 7 individual_profile_page rows = 48, all deduplicated against each other. 11 relayed rows across Phase 0B.5-0B.7 corroborated already-evidenced dishes instead of adding new ones, see corroborationsCount below. Full detail and per-row dedup/mechanic/evidence-gap/naming-ambiguity notes: docs/reports/data/TETO_PROGRESS2_PHASE0B4_recipe-row-evidence.json.
recipeRowEvidence.corroborationsNote: 11 relayed rows across Phase 0B.5-0B.7 matched an already-evidenced dish: Phase 0B.5 -- calabresa-argentina, pizza-baiana (automatic exact match), chicago-deep-dish (manual review, nameJa-suffix mismatch); Phase 0B.6 -- sfincione, supreme, taco-pizza (automatic exact match, page-4 re-confirmation); Phase 0B.7 -- bbq-chicken, apple-cinnamon-dessert, calabresa-argentina (again, 2nd re-confirmation), vongole, aussie (all automatic exact match, page-1 re-confirmation). Recorded as corroborations (new source URL added to the matched row's evidence trail), never double-counted toward evidencedCount.
recipeRowEvidence.individualProfilePageAccessNote: Phase 0B.4 found that direct pagination URLs (/compare/world-pizzas/page/7 etc.) fail for the relaying agent, but individual /pizzas/<slug>/ profile pages remain fetchable via search -- so the remaining population can be evidenced via accumulated individual profiles, not only via pagination. pendingPages above is retained as a reference to the original access path, not a claim that it is the only viable one going forward.

ingredientOccurrenceEvidence.corroborationNote: 36 (tier >=5) + 145 (tiers 4/3/2/1) = 181, which matches EXACTLY the historical '160 canonical pizzas / 181 unique ingredients' figure already on record in docs/design/TETO_RECIPE-MASTER-CATALOG.md section 1 (a figure from prior, separate sessions' PIZZA DB research). This is a strong internal-consistency signal that the ingredient-name universe is now fully enumerated down to occurrence=1 -- but it remains an owner-relayed claim, not independently re-fetched by this Claude session (still EGRESS_BLOCKED), so 'likely, not certain' is the honest status rather than 'true'.
ingredientOccurrenceEvidence.note: IMPORTANT: these are INGREDIENT OCCURRENCE COUNTS (how many of the 172 recipes use this ingredient), not a count of recipes and not a substitute for recipeRowEvidence above. tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py checks the two are never conflated. recipeRowEvidence.evidencedCount is UNCHANGED at 25/172 by this ingestion -- ingredient-name completeness does not imply recipe-row completeness.

candidateCanonicalIngredientUniverseSize.definiteAdditionsNote: Phase 0B.3's 95 genuinely_new entries -- every likely_alias/exact_alias maps onto an already-counted id, so they add 0.
candidateCanonicalIngredientUniverseSize.uncertainAdditionsNote: Phase 0B.3's 11 ambiguous entries -- each could resolve to 0 new ids (merged into its related existing id) or 1 new id (confirmed genuinely distinct), pending a product decision. Never auto-resolved by this ledger.

canonicalizationResultsPhase0B3.excludedNonIngredientNote: 'お好みの具材' (generic 'toppings of your choice' placeholder) -- not a real ingredient, permanently excluded from the canonical universe, never counted in the size range above.

partiallyAddressedInPhase0B7.resolution: 7 new unique rows ingested from a third comparison-table batch (page 1) -- 48/172 evidenced. 5 of the 12 relayed rows (bbq-chicken, apple-cinnamon-dessert, calabresa-argentina, vongole, aussie) turned out to re-confirm Phase 0B's ORIGINAL page-1 samples -- recorded as corroborations, not double-counted (calabresa-argentina is now corroborated twice, Phase 0B.5 and 0B.7). 124 still pending; NOT resolved, only advanced.

6 of the 7 new rows this Phase needed ZERO new ingredient ids -- every ingredient they use was already canonical from Phase 0B/0B.3/0B.6's own prior work (salmon-roe, salmon, eel, sansho-pepper, green-onion, cashew-cheese, zucchini, cabbage, pork, okonomiyaki-sauce, aonori, bonito-flakes, mayo, cumin, parsley, 鶏肉->chicken, 大葉->shiso, all reused). A strong signal the canonical ingredient set built up across Phase 0B.1-0B.6 is already covering a large share of real recurring PIZZA DB ingredients.
